items.name: interactive-address
items.title: Interactive Address
items.description: An interactive contact address with icon links, hover highlights, animated dashed underlines, and blur transitions.
items.docs: This component uses the Doto font via the `font-doto` utility. Load Doto with `next/font/google` and add its CSS variable to your root layout, for example: `const doto = Doto({ subsets: ['latin'], variable: '--font-doto' })`.
